The '''Formos Garrison''' was a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was situated close to the rundown [[Formos Spaceport]]. It had eighteen [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], including two [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]], and was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pavan (Galactic Empire)|Pavan]].
